import pandas as pd
print(pd.read_csv('table.csv').to_string(index=False))
print("SUMMARY END:", Path('summary.txt').read_text()[2200:])
p = Path('chart.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = """    if region != 'South America':
        fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
            x=df.index,
            y=df[region],
            name=region,
            marker=dict(color=color)
        ))"""
new = """    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=df.index,
        y=df[region],
        name=region,
        mode='lines+markers',
        line=dict(color=color),
        marker=dict(color=color)
    ))"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new).replace("yaxis_title='Unemployment Rate (%)'", "yaxis_title='Formal Employment Rate (%)'")
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s, 'chart.py', 'exec'))
print("Trace count:", len(fig.data))
print("Traces:", [(t.name, t.type, t.mode, t.line.color) for t in fig.data])
print("Axis titles:", fig.layout.xaxis.title.text, fig.layout.yaxis.title.text)
print("Y range:", fig.layout.yaxis.range)
